title: Sparse weight edit versus routed hidden-space edit locality
hypothesis: For 16 synthetic counterfactual fact edits on pinned Pythia-70M, a key-routed residual-stream Mirror vector can achieve a +2 target-versus-old answer logit-margin shift with better held-out paraphrase transfer or locality than sparse RoseLoRA output-row edits at comparable actual bytes, and may justify its 512D state over a gated scalar-logit control.
physical_object: Pinned frozen Pythia-70M shared base model and final-layernorm residual state.
mirror_coordinate: One per-edit residual vector m_i selected by exact key-token router and added at the final normalized hidden state.
logical_multiplicity: 16 counterfactual key/value edits; edit count is task coverage, not independent capacity.
controls: Key-routed Mirror residual vector (one 512D m_i per edit)
Unconditional sparse RoseLoRA rank-one output-row edit, fit on support hidden states
Same-key-gated sparse output-row edit control (router charged identically)
Same-key-gated scalar logit-bias control (cheapest direct functional control)

task.definition: Synthetic counterfactual key/value relabelings using unique key strings and one-token old/new answer IDs sampled from ordinary tokenizer vocabulary; no semantic factual-knowledge claim.
task.locality_queries: All held-out paraphrases for the other 15 keys, evaluated separately for each edit intervention.
task.primary_metric: heldout edit success rate (new-token logit > old-token logit) and edit margin gain
secondary_metrics: active compute proxy and stage wall times

edit_rule.key: KEY-00 through KEY-15; router performs exact UTF-8 substring matching on the key string in the prompt. Serialize padded UTF-8 keys, byte lengths and edit indices.
edit_rule.answers: Per seed, sample 32 distinct ordinary token IDs; pair into old/new labels for 16 edits. Score the two answer-token logits only.
edit_rule.mirror_vector: At final-layernorm hidden h, m_i=2*(W_new-W_old)/||W_new-W_old||^2, so linear unembedding raises target-minus-old margin by exactly 2 when routed.
edit_rule.roselora: From mean support final hidden hbar, update only the new-answer output row by deltaW=2*hbar/||hbar||^2. This is rank-one sparse-row weight editing; evaluate globally and with the same exact key gate.
edit_rule.native_bias: Add +2.0 to the new-answer logit only when the exact key router fires; same key metadata is charged.

development.selection_metric: No tuning; test fixed analytic edit construction.

fresh.opening_rule: Open after implementation and development outcomes are committed; no tuning choices are permitted.

storage.authority: Actual uncompressed NPZ inference payload bytes.
paid_objects: base model files for standalone deployment
all gated scalar biases and answer IDs
UTF-8 key strings, byte lengths and edit indices and schema
model/task metadata and deterministic edit seed
storage.reporting: Report exact NPZ sizes for each edit system, incremental state and standalone Pythia total. No support text is required at inference and is not charged as state.

compute.active_compute_proxy: Report support/query model forwards, one 512D vector add, sparse output-row dot products, UTF-8 key-string comparisons, scalar bias operations, scored prompts/tokens and all stage timings.

success_gate: Both dev seeds and all three fresh seeds: Mirror held-out edit success >=.75 and mean margin gain >=1.5; non-target mean KL <=.01; and at the measured quality/locality point Mirror improves over both same-router RoseLoRA and gated scalar bias on a byte/quality Pareto dimension. Fresh stays locked until dev thresholds and provenance pass.
failure_gate: Mirror misses efficacy or locality in any fresh world, or the same-key gated bias/RoseLoRA control matches or dominates its edit/locality outcome at lower or equal actual bytes.
boundaries: This is a synthetic counterfactual edit mechanism screen, not evidence of real-world factual knowledge editing.
One Pythia-70M checkpoint and one final-hidden/logit interface.
Keys are explicit and deterministic; routing generalization to fuzzy aliases is untested.
No claim of independent function capacity from 16 edits.
